## 🚨 honeypot-logon-alert
**What it does:** Splunk is EXPECTED to fire one webhook per successful-logon row (verify at B6c); this workflow builds a Discord embed and POSTs it.

**One workflow, two searches, keyed on `search_name` (name them EXACTLY):**
- `honeypot-weak-cred-logon` (the weak cred was used) -> 🚨 **CRITICAL**
- `honeypot-any-logon` (somebody logged in) -> ⚠️ heads-up

**Severity defaults to CRITICAL:** only the recognized backstop name is downgraded; the primary and any renamed search escalate, and only the primary claims the tripwire fired. A drifted backstop name = a false critical on your own logon; a drifted primary name never downgrades.

**Never Splunk -> Discord directly** (fixed envelope, no embeds -> 400).
